name: ChatGPT Pulse
desc: A daily briefing it researches for you each night.
desc_zh: 夜里自己去查资料、清早推给你的一份每日简报。
solves: A chat assistant only speaks when you open it, so what you never thought to ask is never covered. Pulse researches overnight and delivers a morning digest.
solves_zh: 助手只在你打开它时才开口，所以没想到问的就永远不会被提。Pulse 夜里自己去查，早上送来一份简报。
best_for: You want a short daily digest, and accept that a preview will sometimes miss.
best_for_zh: 你想要一份每日短简报，也接受它作为预览版偶尔跑偏。
notes: 集成在 ChatGPT 内的能力。来源：https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-pulse/
